calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, negate the three-session rolling mean of the overnight open-to-prior-close gap. Positive values indicate accumulated negative gaps and a potential short-term rebound. The signal uses only information available through the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily effect across the full sample; strongest in 2020-2022, positive but weaker in 2023-2024, and materially weaker/unstable in 2025-2026. Interpret the small 15-instrument cross-section conservatively.
